author: Sumpf, Alexandre
title: Russian Civil War
publisher: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, Freie Universitat Berlin
notes: A peer-reviewed, open-access handbook article (version 1.0, 8 October 2014; DOI 10.15463/ie1418.10171), read in full. Used here for a compact post-archival statement of what the Whites lacked and for the pogrom figure, both of which it states in its own words rather than reporting. Being a handbook article it gives no pages and no apparatus for individual numbers; it is context and framing, not the place a figure is checked.
